items.title: Continuous accountability for Verified bots

sentences.en: Continuous accountability for Verified bots.
A driver’s license tells you who someone is and that they passed a driving test, not whether they’ll drive responsibly in the future.
The same is true for bots: verifying who operates it creates accountability, but trust depends on what it does next.
A known bot can still ignore website preferences, overwhelm origins, or evade controls.
It’s not always malicious — often it’s just a misconfiguration or a bug.

As we described in a previous blog post on bot behavior, we strive to verify two questions: “Are you who you say you are?” and “Can we trust you?” To be a Cloudflare Verified Bot, you broadly need to meet three criteria: Identify yourself accurately and securely Do only what you say you will do Don’t engage in abusive behavior Bots use Web Bot Auth to sign requests that establish their identity, which BotBase then catalogues in an open format.
With identification addressed, our focus shifts to the second cardinal rule of Verified bots: thou shalt do no harm .

Today we introduce a system to evaluate and report when Verified bot behavior starts to deviate from this rule, ensuring that the answer to “Can we trust you?” remains “Yes.” This is where the distinction between risk and trust becomes important: Risk describes the likelihood that a particular request or point-in-time action may be harmful, and it can change from one moment to the next.
Trust is built over time through repeated and consistent behavior.

For example, we de-listed Perplexity’s bot from our Verified bot list in 2025 when it sought to access resources on websites that opted out of scraping and subsequently attempted to circumvent controls when those requests were blocked.
Do not engage in abusive behavior This simple requirement sounds like a freebie, but there is a lot of nuance in that statement.
When crawlers don’t respect site preferences , that undermines trust.

items.title: The next developer interface is ambient intelligence

sentences.en: The next developer interface is ambient intelligence.
For most of my career, building software started with the same setup: keyboard, mouse, editor, terminal, browser, and an impressive number of tabs I was definitely going to look at later.
The tools changed, but the relationship did not.
Like most developers, I learned commands, memorized shortcuts, and adapted my thinking to the machine.
AI is changing that relationship and not because I can prompt my way to some workable code.

It s more because the system behind it can understand a repository, choose the right model, plan work, use tools, edit files, run commands, inspect failures, and keep going within boundaries the developer controls.

We ve made it possible for a developer to describe an outcome, and GitHub Copilot can gather repository context, inspect symbols and dependencies, edit files, run tests, and revise the implementation.
In the IDE, agent mode keeps that loop interactive.
GitHub Copilot coding agent can take an issue into an isolated GitHub Actions-powered environment and return a pull request for review.
This is not just faster coding.
It is the shift from issuing commands to making intent executable.
The developer still owns the outcome, but the work looks subtly different.

items.title: Staying Evergreen: How we automated secure access and repo hygiene in a shared org

sentences.en: Staying Evergreen: How we automated secure access and repo hygiene in a shared org.
Working with outside collaborators can add more work for a repository owner.
You need to confirm who still needs access, change permissions as projects evolve, and archive repositories once they ve served their purpose.
To keep up, repository owners need to track collaborators, deadlines, and follow-ups for each repository.
As a project grows, that manual housekeeping becomes harder to keep up with and easier to defer.
We faced this problem in a shared organization where GitHub employees ( Hubbers ) collaborate with customers and partners on product trials and professional services engagements.
Our answer was Evergreen , a GitHub App built with native GitHub features.
The workflows below exhibit a pattern you can adapt for your own organization.
Meet Evergreen Evergreen is a GitHub App that automates organization hygiene through two workflows: Outside collaborator access reviews.
Every quarter, each repo s outside collaborators are reviewed.
Keep who you need, and everyone else is removed.
Stale repository detection and archival.

items.title: A fully programmable secure web gateway

sentences.en: A fully programmable secure web gateway.
Every secure web gateway on the market works the same way: traffic matches a condition.
A terminal action fires.
Allow, Block, Isolate, Log.
This model has been the foundation of network security for nearly 30 years, and it handles the common case well.
But it has a ceiling, and customers with complex environments hit that ceiling regularly.
Earlier this year, we shared our vision to build a truly programmable SASE platform .
We also outlined how the term programmability has become diluted by the security industry.
Most vendors claim programmability because they have public APIs, Terraform providers, webhooks, and alerting.
Cloudflare offers all of those things too, but that’s not enough.
True programmability means running your own code — arbitrary logic that you wrote for your specific environment — inline in the policy evaluation path, at the moment a security decision is made.
Today, we’re excited to announce Cloudflare is bringing true programmability to Cloudflare Gateway and DLP (Data Loss Prevention) by integrating it with the entirety of our edge computing platform.

items.title: Nicolás Maduro tells New York court new torture allegations are ‘false’

sentences.en: Nicolás Maduro tells New York court new torture allegations are ‘false’.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉斯·马杜罗（ Nicolás Maduro ）告诉纽约法院，新的酷刑指控是“虚假的”。

sentences.en: Rewritten indictment accuses ex-Venezuela president and wife Cilia Flores of leading campaign of torture Nicolás Maduro insisted on Thursday during an appearance in a New York court that torture allegations in a rewritten drug trafficking indictment against the deposed Venezuelan president and his wife were “false accusations”.
sentences.zh: 重写的起诉书指责前委内瑞拉总统和妻子西莉亚·弗洛雷斯（ Cilia Flores ）领导酷刑运动，尼古拉斯·马杜罗（ Nicolás Maduro ）周四在纽约法院出庭时坚持认为，重写的针对被废黜的委内瑞拉总统及其妻子的贩毒起诉书中的酷刑指控是“虚假指控”。

sentences.en: Maduro, shackled at the ankles, was brought to court to face the new charges accusing the couple of leading a state-sponsored campaign of repression that tortured scores of victims, including three Americans.
sentences.zh: 马杜罗被铐在脚踝上，被带上法庭面对新的指控，指控这对夫妇领导了一场国家支持的镇压运动，折磨了包括三名美国人在内的数十名受害者。
